name: 132 kV busbar potential transformer
description: 132 kV busbar potential transformer for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Procurement / Electrical. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts.

specifications.metric: 132 kV capacitive voltage transformer  — nominal system voltage / highest voltage for equipment Um
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 Version 6.0, Date of Issue May 2024, Appendix 1 132kV table: 'Nominal System Voltage 132 kV'; 'Highest Voltage for Equipment Um (rms) 145 kV'.

specifications.metric: 132 kV capacitive voltage transformer  — rated short-time thermal current
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 132kV table: 'Rated short time thermal current Minimum 31.5kA for 3 secs but not less than that of associated HV Switchgear'. CONFLICT: the project line item prints '40kA (3s)'; this utility spec prints 31.5 kA/3 s minimum but requires not less than the associated switchgear, so a 40 kA/3 s bay would require at least 40 kA/3 s. specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 132kV table: 'Rated Secondary Voltage 110/√3 V'; 'Ratios 132000/√3 : 110/√3'.

specifications.metric: 132 kV capacitive voltage transformer  — rated output per winding
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 132kV table: 'Output 50VA per winding'; 'Number of secondary outputs 3'.

specifications.metric: 132 kV capacitive voltage transformer  — voltage factor
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 132kV table: 'Voltage Factor 1.2 Continuous / 1.5 for 30 sec'.

specifications.metric: 132 kV capacitive voltage transformer  — lightning impulse withstand (dry impulse, peak)
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 132kV table: 'Rated insulation levels of the primary winding - (peak) - Dry Impulse 650 kV'.

specifications.metric: 132 kV capacitive voltage transformer  — power frequency withstand (wet 1 min)
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 132kV table: 'Rated insulation levels of the primary winding - (Wet 1min PF Withstand) 275 kV'.

specifications.metric: 132 kV capacitive voltage transformer  — minimum phase-to-earth creepage distance
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 132kV table: 'Minimum phase to earth creepage distance 3350mm'; pollution level 3 = 25 mm/kV (Heavy).

specifications.metric: 132 kV capacitive voltage transformer  — secondary terminal enclosure degree of protection
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), clause 3.1.4: 'This enclosure shall as a minimum comply with IP 44 in accordance with IEC 60529'.
